rows.words: worst month's volatility in the 2008 and 2020 replays within 30% of real
maximum drawdown in the 2008 and 2020 replays within 30% of real
peak stock correlation in the 2008 and 2020 replays within 0.15 of real
share of sessions with the VIX above 30
mean length of a fear spell above VIX 30, sessions
20% bear markets per decade
10% corrections per decade
sessions down more than 5% per decade
share of sessions with the VIX under 15
index annual volatility, %
long-run index return, % a year

rows.words: sd of annual index log returns, years 2-21, per cent; the start-up drift: sd of the first 60 sessions' index return over the steady state's, across 50 markets
crash rate in years 3-21 against years 1-2
histories touching the VIX ceiling, of 30
edge from reading a headline 5 ticks late, bp
65-minute lag-1 autocorrelation of print returns, median name; Roll spread over quoted

rows.words: the price-only rule furthest over its line on tf-suite-2026.1 (named in `worst`): median points over buy-and-hold, markets beaten of 20
rows.rule: every rule at most +5 points and 14 of 20

rows.words: stock-level (idiosyncratic) variance ratio at 60 sessions, median name, 30 histories of 2,660 sessions
rank IC of the value signal on published fundamentals against the next 20 sessions: whole history, first 60 sessions
rank IC of 12-1 and 6-1 month momentum against the next 20 sessions
Lo-MacKinlay one-day loser-minus-winner book, bp a day
the cost of size in the agent-facing book: exponent and coefficient of the average cost against Q/V, in sigma units (impact_curve.py)
rows.rule: exponent in 0.4 to 0.7 and coefficient in 0.33 to 0.67

rows.words: sd of the 2-year Treasury yield's daily change, bp (FRED DGS2 2015-2025)
sd of the 10-year Treasury yield's daily change, bp (FRED DGS10)
daily correlation of the roster index with a Treasury bond's return (minus the 10-year's change; SPY against IEF)
daily correlation of the roster index with an IG bond's return (minus the corporate yield's change; SPY against LQD)
the aggregate earnings fall around a contraction, median over the 30 histories' contractions (Shiller 1953-2020)
the driven 2020-21 market: the index's maximum drawdown and the sessions from the pre-crash high back to it, medians over histories (driven2020.py)
rows.rule: drawdown in 0.237 to 0.441 and sessions in 63 to 252

rows.words: the driven 2020 path's fast crash: the high to the lowest close within 60 sessions, and the sessions it took (driven2020.py)
rows.rule: drop in 0.237 to 0.441 within 12 to 46 sessions

rows.words: look-through: sessions from the index's trough to the aggregate earnings level's trough on the driven 2020 path (driven2020.py)
the driven 2022 market: the index's maximum drawdown (driven2022.py)
the driven 2022 market: the market P/E's log change per 100 bp of the corporate yield, monthly averages (driven2022.py)
timing rules on published macro data against buy-and-hold, and the drift after a published turn (c10.py)

rows.words: the audit's rate-news agent through tf.evaluate: mean annual excess over holding in points, histories ahead (r7_eval.py)
rows.rule: at most 0 points a year, ahead in at most 20 of 30

the packaged recession: seeds whose cycle has left contraction and trough within 24 months of the onset (recession_rows.py)
the packaged recession: the index's own rise in the 252 sessions after its low, per cent, mean over seeds (recession_rows.py)
the index's variance ratio at two and five years relative to one, years 2-21 of the pooled free histories (v1.py)
ruled bands of the one-year realism table in, on all four cells
